title: The upstream push guard misses the upstream given as an absolute path, a file:// url, a trailing slash or a ../ detour
goal: kbpublic.is_upstream refuses a push to the upstream remote's repository however its url is written (a relative or absolute path, a trailing slash, file://, a ../ detour of the same repository), by comparing resolved locations, so every push to the fetch-only upstream is refused as ST-s6iz6z36's goal says

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();up=os.path.join(t,'up.git');c=os.path.join(t,'clone');g=lambda *a,cwd=None:subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True);g('init','-q','--bare',up);g('init','-q',c);g('remote','add','upstream','../up.git',cwd=c);g('config','kb.upstreamRemote','upstream',cwd=c);r=os.path.realpath(up);forms=[r,r+'/','file://'+r,'../clone/../up.git'];m=[f for f in forms if not kbpublic.is_upstream(f,c,url=f)];print('upstream url forms not refused:',m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)
